quarterly_data.quarter: Sandisk press release: Kioxia and Sandisk Unveil New High-Performance QLC 3D Flash (08-12-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Kioxia and Sandisk unveiled their 9th-generation 2Tb QLC 3D flash memory technology for AI-driven storage, built on their CMOS directly Bonded to Array (CBA) architecture by pairing an advanced CMOS wafer with a proven memory-array platform. Versus the 8th-generation 2Tb QLC it has a 6-plane architecture with higher write and read bandwidth, better write and read power efficiency, and a NAND interface speed of 4.8Gb/s, a 33% improvement. Sandisk CTO Alper Ilkbahar: AI adoption is accelerating storage-interface transitions, and the technology lets Sandisk bring capabilities to market 'more quickly with exceptional capital efficiency'. No shipment date was given.
